title: 郭財吉教授入選全球前2%頂尖科學家
title_en: Prof. Tsai-Chi Kuo Named among the World's Top 2% Scientists
paragraphs: 郭財吉教授入選「全球前2%頂尖科學家」，名列「終身科學影響力排行榜」與「2025年度科學影響力排行榜」，研究領域為工業工程與自動化
paragraphs_en: Prof. Tsai-Chi Kuo has been named among the World's Top 2% Scientists in both the career-long and 2025 single-year scientific impact rankings, in the field of industrial engineering and automation.
